name: refd agent-facing API
description: refd's agent interface is a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP) behind OAuth 2.1. This catalog documents the public endpoints: OAuth discovery and flow, and the MCP endpoint itself. Access is read-only by default; an optional data:write scope adds bounded workspace setup tools, row-scoped prompt management for onboarded workspaces, and a self-revocation tool. The nine read tools, the nineteen write tools, and the metric-glossary resource are discovered at runtime via MCP `tools/list` and `resources/list`. A grant covers the workspaces selected at consent (or all of them). Workspace data routes used by the dashboard are session-authenticated and intentionally not part of the agent surface.
